model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира сравнението на резултатите от различни методи върху три набора от данни: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като резултатите са представени като проценти на точност. Хоризонталната ос съдържа етикетите на трите набора от данни, които са подредени последователно и нямат определена скала. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Accuracy (%)" и показва стойности от 50 до 62 с интервал от 2, като скалата е линейна. Диаграмата представя шест групи стълби, всяка от които съответства на различен метод: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection и PPO. Всеки метод е представен със стълб за всеки от трите набора от данни, като стълбите за всеки метод са групирани заедно според набора от данни. Представителни стойности са както следва: за Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection показва около 56%, докато PPO показва около 53%; за MMLU, SRPO показва около 56%, докато DAPO показва около 55%; за Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection показва около 61%, а GRPO показва около 58%. Някои стълби са визуално подчертани чрез щриховка или цвят, но няма допълнителни бележки или засенчване, които да извличат вниманието към конкретни групи. Стълбите са подредени според набора от данни, а не според стойностите на точност.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph presents a comparison of accuracy percentages across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, with six distinct methods or models being evaluated: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The horizontal axis lists the categories Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, in that order, while the vertical axis on the left side is labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranging from 50 to 62 in increments of 2. Each method is represented by a specific color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection is depicted in solid blue, DAPO in gray with diagonal lines, SRPO in solid peach, GRPO in diagonal peach lines, PPO+Self-reflection in solid green, and PPO in diagonal green lines. For Mathverse, the bars are approximately: DAPO+Self-reflection at 56, DAPO at 53, SRPO at 55, GRPO at 53, PPO+Self-reflection at 54, and PPO at 53. For MMLU, the values are roughly: DAPO+Self-reflection at 57, DAPO at 56, SRPO at 56, GRPO at 56, PPO+Self-reflection at 55, and PPO at 54. Lastly, for Physics, the approximate values are: DAPO+Self-reflection at 61, DAPO at 58, SRPO at 60, GRPO at 58, PPO+Self-reflection at 59, and PPO at 57. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and none are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining. The graph provides a clear visual representation of the accuracy percentages for each method across the three categories.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, listed in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, with a scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked at regular intervals of 2, and labeled with units of percentage (%). Each category features six bars, representing DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO, distinguished by different colors. In the Mathverse category, the bars have approximate values of 56, 53, 55, 54, 54, and 53, respectively. For MMLU, the values are around 56, 56, 56, 56, 55, and 55, respectively. In the Physics category, the values are approximately 61, 58, 60, 58, 59, and 57, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and standard representation.
model_annotations.German: This grouped bar chart displays accuracy percentages for three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis lists these categories in order, with each category having four grouped bars representing different combinations of methods: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 50 to 62, with a linear scale and tick labels at regular intervals of 2. The grouped bars for each category are visually distinct, with consistent colors across categories: blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, grey for DAPO, orange for SRPO, peach for GRPO, green for PPO+Self-reflection, and light blue for PPO. In the Mathverse category, DAPO+Self-reflection has an accuracy of approximately 56%, while PPO+Self-reflection has an accuracy of around 54%. For MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO both have accuracies slightly above 56%, and for Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection has an accuracy of approximately 61%, and SRPO has an accuracy of around 59%. The bars are not sorted in any specific order within each category, and no bars are visually highlighted.
